claim.statement: GitLab's current beta documentation says tool-governance enforcement for background flows such as Duo Developer was added in GitLab 19.3 behind a disabled-by-default feature flag; background flows support Always Allow and Always Deny, not Always Ask, and an unconfigured background rule defaults to Always Allow.

source.title: Agent tool governance
source.locator: History, background-flow enforcement and Known issues

values: unconfigured background rule defaults to Always Allow

lifecycle.reason: Background enforcement introduced as a feature-flagged beta after the dossier's 18.8 anchor.

limitations: This claim postdates GitLab 18.8 and does not establish 18.8 approval behavior.
Always Ask does not apply to the background path because no user is present to answer an inline prompt.
unknowns: The tool-authority policy used by Developer Flow in GitLab 18.8 remains unresolved.
The effective 19.3 feature flag and group or project rules for any execution are unknown.
